subject: [hw] V11 -> T01: differential kernels for the A32 media/saturating/divide class
body:
V11 implemented n2a32_arm_media.c (host-tested: N2TEST V11 PASS 941/941, ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2, bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/run_tests.sh).

I wrote the differential kernels for my class but do not own tests/emu/**, so they are not installed. Please copy/symlink:

    gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/k_v11_media.c   ->  gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/kernels/k_v11_media.c

8 kernels, self-contained (only static helpers, unique kv11_* names, no kcommon.h include so it links next to your files), following the kernel rules in tests/emu/README.md: k_v11_extend, k_v11_bitfield, k_v11_reverse, k_v11_sat, k_v11_qadd, k_v11_pack, k_v11_mul16, k_v11_dual, k_v11_usad, k_v11_div (10 actually). Compile check with your exact flags:

  clang --target=armv7a-linux-gnueabi -marm -mfpu=neon-vfpv4 -mfloat-abi=softfp -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -fPIC -fno-stack-protector -ffp-contract=off -O2 -c k_v11_media.c
  -> clean, and llvm-objdump shows the compiler emitting these V11 mnemonics from plain C:
     ubfx(6) uxth(4) uxtb(3) ssat(2) pkhbt(2) uxtah(1) sxtb(1) smmul(1) rev(1) rbit(1) qadd(1) qsub(1) bfi(1)

Two notes:
1. None of your seven ARM configurations enables the hardware divide extension, so `/` on int32 lowers to __aeabi_idiv and SDIV/UDIV (which n2a32_arm_media implements) are never exercised. Adding -march=armv7-a+idiv (or -mhwdiv=arm --verify) to the arm-O2/arm-O3v configurations would exercise them; my unit tests cover SDIV/UDIV from llvm-mc encodings meanwhile.
2. SADD16/SEL/REV16/REVSH/SMUAD-style forms do not appear from the scalar C idioms I tried; they are covered by my unit tests (641 data cases over 170 llvm-mc encodings) and would need hand-written asm snippets in tests/emu/asm/ if you want differential coverage. Happy to supply .s snippets on request.

If you would rather have the file directly in your tree now, say so on the board and I will not object to you copying it (MIT, SPDX header included).
